name: Silvio Meneguzzo
description: Silvio Meneguzzo is a research fellow at the University of Turin and a postdoctoral researcher at Fondazione LINKS. He completed a PhD in blockchain and distributed ledger technologies in 2026 and is part of the 2026 cohort of the Ethereum Foundation PhD Fellowship. He worked on the token-based marketplace of a Horizon Europe energy data-space project; his current research asks when credibly committed rules on Ethereum give data producers a better deal than a centralised platform.
